meowth-night-slash.name: Night Slash
meowth-night-slash.description: Bond skill: a slash from the shadows (Power 85, Attack); a knockout gives back 1 Bond.

meowth-fake-out.name: Fake Out
meowth-fake-out.description: Bond skill: a startling first strike (Power 50, Attack) that Slows the foe for 1 turn.

meowth-hyper-voice.name: Hyper Voice
meowth-hyper-voice.description: Bond skill: a piercing yowl at a foe up to 3 hexes away (Power 85).

meowth-technician.name: Technician
meowth-technician.description: Its Normal-type moves deal 15% more damage.

meowth-limber.name: Limber
meowth-limber.description: Its supple body can't be held: immune to Paralysis and Slow.

meowth-bite.name: Bite
meowth-bite.description: New skill: a quick bite with sharp fangs (Power 55).

meowth-screech.name: Screech
meowth-screech.description: New skill: an ear-splitting screech leaves a foe up to 2 hexes away Exposed for 2 turns.

meowth-pickup.name: Pickup
meowth-pickup.description: Always finds something on a beaten foe: each knockout gives the team 1 Bond.

meowth-cats-grace.name: Cat's Grace
meowth-cats-grace.description: Slinks away from engaged foes without drawing free strikes.

meowth-swift.name: Swift
meowth-swift.description: New skill: star-shaped rays at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 60); Slows 1 turn.

meowth-opportunist.name: Opportunist
meowth-opportunist.description: Deals 20% more damage to foes engaged with one of its allies.

meowth-lithe-body.name: Lithe Body
meowth-lithe-body.description: Twists away from blows: takes 10% less damage.

meowth-play-rough.name: Play Rough
meowth-play-rough.description: New skill: pounces and plays rough with a foe (Power 85).

meowth-tri-attack.name: Tri Attack
meowth-tri-attack.description: New skill: a triangle of energy at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 80).

meowth-pounce.name: Pounce
meowth-pounce.description: Its free strikes on foes breaking away deal 25% more damage.

meowth-amulet-coin.name: Amulet Coin
meowth-amulet-coin.description: The team starts each battle with 1 extra Bond.

meowth-sucker-punch.name: Sucker Punch
meowth-sucker-punch.description: New skill: a sneaky strike before the foe can react (Power 90).

meowth-hyper-beam.name: Hyper Beam
meowth-hyper-beam.description: New skill: a devastating beam at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 100).

meowth-relentless-swipes.name: Relentless Swipes
meowth-relentless-swipes.description: Each hit in a row on the same foe deals 10% more damage (up to 3 stacks).

meowth-feline-focus.name: Feline Focus
meowth-feline-focus.description: Regains 2 movement when it knocks out a foe on its turn.

meowth-alley-cat-king.name: Alley Cat King
meowth-alley-cat-king.description: Capstone. A knockout lets it use its basic attack again; its free strikes give the team 1 Bond.

meowth-jackpot.name: Jackpot
meowth-jackpot.description: Capstone. Each combo it lands gives the team 1 Bond; deals 15% more damage to foes at full HP.

meowth-growl.name: Growl
meowth-growl.description: New skill: a cute growl leaves an adjacent foe Weakened for 2 turns.
